Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Mahajan
 Order

1. The present application is filed by the applicant seeking regular bail in FIR No.18/2024 dated 19.01.2024, registered at Police Station Sarita Vihar for offences under Sections 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 2.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Issue notice.
3. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State accepts notice.
4. Notice be issued to the victim through the Investigating Officer 5.
Let the Status Report be filed before the next date of hearing.
6. The nominal roll of the applicant be also requisitioned from the concerned Jail Superintendent before the next date of hearing.
